TestDecimalPrecision()

This test exercises that when sitting a decimal osu.Framework.Bindables.BindableNumber`1.Precision like 0.1 on a BindableNumber<float>, the resulting osu.Framework.Bindables.BindableNumber`1.Value is the closest to the actual closest float number to the real-world decimal. This matters because certain methods of rounding to the precision specified on the osu.Framework.Bindables.BindableNumber`1 cause rounding errors that show up elsewhere in undesirable ways.

[Test]
public void TestDecimalPrecision()
